# Horse Racing Companion

> An independent iPhone app for race-day attendees at Del Mar. For each race it
> turns public odds, Del Mar history, and live race-day updates into one clear
> single-race pick, or an honest no-pick explanation, with one clear
> pick, estimated chances, confidence, and supporting factors. It does
> not accept wagering funds, execute or
> transmit wagers, connect to a betting operator, or operate a simulated betting
> game or virtual bankroll. Any wagering transaction happens outside the app.
> It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Del Mar Thoroughbred
> Club.

Key facts:
- Platform: iPhone (iOS). The first three racing days are free and include
  complete race-day picks. After that, the app may offer one non-renewing
  pass for the displayed Del Mar season. The app and App Store show the exact
  price and access end date before purchase, and the pass never renews
  automatically. It is not a deposit, wagering balance, credit, virtual
  currency, or payment method for a wager. Race cards, results, and the
  how-it-works explanation stay free without a pass.
- The analysis uses public information only: morning-line odds and past Del
  Mar results (each horse's local record, trainer, jockey, their pairing, and
  post-position performance by surface and distance). No profit is guaranteed
  and pick confidence is not a win probability.
- The model was developed using more than 1,800 archived Del Mar races with
  matched official results. Research compares the model's full probability
  estimates using established measures including log loss and Brier score,
  and treats short histories cautiously. An independent adversarial audit
  found no direct current-outcome or future-history leakage and led to seven
  corrections. It did not establish statistical superiority over the prior
  model. The formal sealed prospective evaluation has not begun, so the site
  does not claim a proven betting edge or profitability.
- Predictions are explicitly labeled by outcome type, including Win, Place,
  or Show where applicable. The strongest model signal is highlighted;
  genuinely unclear races may show no pick with a specific reason. Pick confidence is
  shown as a visual meter, not a win probability. Race detail may show an
  estimated total return for the track's minimum stake using current odds;
  final pools and post-time odds determine any actual payout.
- There is no adjustable stake control, teller wording, betting-window
  instruction, wagering account, deposit flow, operator connection, or wager
  execution or transmission.
- Live picks normally begin about two hours before the day's first
  race. The app shows that day's expected opening time. Before then,
  "Live Picks Open Later" is a normal scheduled state; "Live Updates
  Delayed" is reserved for missing fresh data after the window opens.
- Initial live record through August 22, 2026: 10 of 23 finalized pre-race
  picks matched their published result type (43.5%) across 36 settled races;
  the app passed the other 13 races instead of forcing a pick. All picks use
  model v0.4 + ticket policy v0.4 and were frozen before the official finish.
  At track minimum stakes, the 23 picks represented $47 in hypothetical cost
  and $31.10 in official returns (-33.8% hypothetical ROI). This small sample
  does not establish profitability or a proven betting edge.
- Responsible wagering: for adults of legal wagering age where wagering is
  lawful. Problem-gambling help: https://www.ncpgambling.org/
